findings.description: The cursor safety fix only takes the minimum over chunks that yielded blocks. If the request cap fires in an early chunk before later chunks run, `completedChunkSlots` still contains that early chunk's partial high-water mark and `result.lastSlot` advances to it. Because resume reads the max `sqd-stream` event slot for the whole collection, all later chunks resume from that advanced slot despite never covering the earlier range.
findings.failure_mode: A capped run can ingest slots 0..N for chunk 0, write events at slot N, then stop before chunk 1. The next run starts chunk 1 at N, permanently skipping chunk 1 mints from 0..N.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat unvisited chunks as only covered through the starting cursor. If `stats.stoppedAtCap` occurs before every chunk has reached the candidate safe slot, keep `lastSlot` at the previous cursor, or persist per-chunk cursors and resume each chunk independently.
findings.demotion_reason: Demoted: anchor not in diff scope

findings.description: The new activation regression workflow installs with `npm ci`, but this repo is pnpm-managed and has no `package-lock.json`. `npm ci` requires an npm lockfile and will fail before typecheck or regression tests run.
findings.failure_mode: Every push/PR matching this workflow fails at the install step with an npm usage error, so the regression guard is unusable.
findings.suggested_fix: Use pnpm consistently in this workflow: set up pnpm, set up Node with `cache: pnpm`, then run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm vitest ...` or `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`.

findings.cross_file_justification: The diff adds `test:gate`, which is what the new gate workflow executes; the referenced integration test/fixture determine whether the new gate enforces the §4.5 requirement.
findings.description: `test:gate` runs an integration test that passes vacuously against a zero-event fixture instead of the required 30,006-event reconciliation. With `event_count: 0` and `slot_range` 0..0, the test does no SQD streaming and computes `match_rate = 1.0` by definition.
findings.failure_mode: A broken decoder or SQD stream integration can still pass the required §4.5 gate because the CI gate reconciles zero reference events and reports PASS.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the gate fail or skip as blocked unless the real non-empty Pythians fixture is present and has the expected event count/hash. Do not allow `event_count === 0` to satisfy the release gate.
